rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulam, equating attainment of siddhis with the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula in relation to the eight attainments of powers?
premises: The attainment of siddhis is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis is declared to be the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific eight siddhis are not named in this verse and rely on prior context.
items.plain_english: And these eight, O fair-faced one, along with the attainment of the siddhis, constitute the root Kaula.
